title: Spacious Quiet Oasis | WFH space + 15 Min Downtown
description:
Welcome to your home away from home in Nashville! This spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers plenty of room for families, friend groups, business travelers, and extended stays. It has 2 living rooms, 2 desks for WFH, a fully stocked kitchen, and even a ping pong table. It's just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville and 15 minutes from the airport, nestled in a quiet neighborhood.

The space
* 4 spacious bedrooms
* 3 full bathrooms
* Fully equipped kitchen for cooking and dining
* Additional kitchenette/bar area for entertaining and extra convenience
* Dedicated private office with workspace and high-speed Wi-Fi
* Spacious primary suite with private bathroom
* Multiple living rooms for relaxing, socializing, or accommodating larger groups
* Laundry facilities available for guest use
* Plenty of free parking space for several cars
* Even a ping pong table and a piano!

Guest access
This rental includes access to the entire private property along with a spacious yard and outdoor deck.

Please note the garage is off limits to guests.

Other things to note
There are 5 beds in 4 bedrooms, plus a futon in the office that converts into a bed.

Please read through our rules carefully.
* No parties or events
* No smoking inside 
* Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM
* No unregistered guests
* No Pets

Any rule violations may result in additional charges, cancellation without refund, and removal from the property.

There is an exterior security camera in use for guest safety.
